plugins.name: Fallout 4 Pip-Boy
plugins.author: MoonBench / Strip-Boy
plugins.description: Sync your stick LEDs to the Fallout 4 Pip-Boy's green-phosphor CRT — the breathing phosphor glow, the flicker, and the channel-swap static. Installs a Pip-Boy preset and auto-activates it whenever the Fallout 4 companion app is in front. Pair with the Strip-Boy patch for live, per-frame screen sync.
